routes.label: Estimate and verify the nearest choice

question: The expression \(2.46 \times 8.163 \times (5.17 + 4.829)\) is closest to
solution:
First add inside the parentheses: \(5.17+4.829=9.999\). Rounding the three factors to convenient nearby numbers suggests
\[
2.46\times8.163\times9.999
\approx2.5\times8\times10=200.
\]
We can verify the closest choice without calculating the full product. Let \(P\) denote the exact product. We have
\[
2.4<2.46<2.5,\qquad 8<8.163<9,
\]
\[
9<9.999<10.
\]
All factors are positive, so multiplying the lower bounds and the upper bounds gives
\[
172.8=2.4\times8\times9<P<2.5\times9\times10=225.
\]
The midpoints between \(200\) and its neighboring choices \(100\) and \(300\) are \(150\) and \(250\). Since \(150<P<250\), the exact value is closest to \(\boxed{200}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
